properties.description: The patch in which search reads every prose field (#738): a change's rationale and 14 other fields join the full-text index, a test makes each text property either searched or named as not prose, and an index built over a different field list rebuilds itself when its store opens. Cut so the root-cause skill's first search, the raw error, finds the fix that quoted it, on flo2.io and through --call alike.
